query: Please implement a lightweight validation website for verifying user input data. The website should have functionalities for form validation, data verification, and error notification. Users should be able to input data, submit forms, and the website will verify the correctness of the data and display error messages. Configure all backgrounds with vanilla and all components with dark goldenrod.
